injection_details.target_discovery: Process enumeration using CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, and Process32Next searching for process name explorer.exe
injection_details.payload_writing: Memory allocated in target process via VirtualAllocEx and payload path written via WriteProcessMemory

anti_analysis: peb_beingdebugged (checks BeingDebugged flag in PEB via %gs:0x60 + 0x2)

decoded_strings.g_encrypted_dll_path: DLL path string decrypted at runtime in WinMain prior to injection into explorer.exe

encryption_details.key_storage: Stored in .rdata section at symbol g_xor_key (VA 0x140004000)
